unit: Create B1 Harness Spreadsheet / Build Header Payload guard
description: Setup throws immediately if the spreadsheet id it is about to write to is the production register id, or is empty.
why_it_exists: The isolated harness only stays isolated while its target id is provably not production. The check is a hard throw before the first write payload is even built, so a mis-copied id can never reach a values:batchUpdate.
assertions: An empty spreadsheetId throws 'No spreadsheetId returned.' before any payload is built.
A spreadsheetId equal to the production register id throws 'Refusing: production spreadsheet id returned.'
The guard runs before the header payload is constructed, so no write body containing the production id ever exists.
The final Verify step independently re-asserts is_not_production by comparing the id again after the writes.
target_unresolved_reason: Administrative / QA-infrastructure workflow. No WF1-WF5/WF9 Code node implements it.
